description: An agent-first sidebar for fleets of agent threads. Cards show the issue or pull request link, children, and model and effort; a Specs section shows each running spec's tickets as dots, with what needs you now and later; the footer counts running threads and opens a hover card; Pinned, Inbox and Specs collapse; drag pins and reorders; and every WizBar action has a wizbar CLI command with JSON. Derived from T3 Sidebar.
